newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX index falls as blue chips stagnate.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX index falls as blue chips stagnate.

text.p: Major Slovak shares did not trade or closed lower in listless trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Friday, pulling the SAX index down 0.67 points to 194.78.
Brokers said the market desperately needed fresh impulses to reverse the current downward trend.

"I don't think the forthcoming annual shareholders meetings would be such impulses," Libor Briska of Creditanstalt said. "Some significantly good company results or new issues would help much more," he said.
The only two blue chips trading on even moderate volumes on the BSE floor were steel maker VSZ and drug producer Slovakofarma, but both lost ground.
VSZ eased 11 crowns to 730, with 509 shares traded and Slovakofarma fell by 210 to 4,000 crowns, with 1,000 traded shares.
Overall, volume eased to 220,928 shares, from 351,350 shares traded on Thursday, while turnover decreased to 125.16 million, from 185.26 million.
